title: Monterey Bay Whale Watching
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
No walkers or wheelchairs allowed for safety reasons
Not Available for infants or children under 3 years old due to safety reasons
All passengers must be able to support themselves with both hands at all times with the motion of the boat
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Sea Goddess Whale Watching promises a once-in-a-lifetime whale watching experience. Our whale watching tours depart from Moss Landing, right at the mouth of the Monterey Bay Canyon, one of the largest underwater canyons in the world! This nutrient-rich zone attracts all types of marine life, making Moss Landing the best place for whale watching tours in the entire Monterey Bay. With many migratory whales, we’re able to offer guaranteed whale sightings year-round.

Since we our tours depart out of Moss Landing – Less Travel Time than Monterey wharf departures, and More Whale Watching Time!

The Biggest & Nicest Boats on Monterey Bay with 360 Degree walk around deck, interior cabin with windows and clean bathrooms

Premium VIP Upper Deck seating available (best for viewing)

Favorite Whale Watching Tour by both locals and tourists

Marine Biologist Tour Guides to narrate your experience

FREE parking on street if available
